content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the temporary full-time position under the Centre for Sustainable Energy at IIT Madras.

content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be citizens of India. Persons who have migrated from Pakistan with the intention of permanently settling in India or subjects of Nepal are also eligible, subject to a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India in the Ministry of Home Affairs. Experience and Skills: Sound understanding of chemical/process systems and safe operation of laboratory or pilot-scale equipment. Hands-on experience with HT-HP reactors, pressure vessels/autoclaves, hydrothermal or supercritical-fluid systems, or similar pressurized process equipment is strongly preferred. Working knowledge of valves, pumps, pressure gauges/transducers, thermocouples, temperature controllers, tubing and fittings, pressure-relief devices, and associated process instrumentation.

rows.qualification_required: B.E./B.Tech, Chemical Engineering Process Engineering, Petrochemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline from a recognized institution.

content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Salary
content_sections.text: The position is temporary and on a purely contract basis for an initial period of one year, extendable based on performance.

rows.pay_level_pay: Rs. 21,500 to Rs. 75,000 based on qualifications and experience

content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises shortlisting based on online applications followed by a test or interview. Candidates are short-listed for Test/Interview on the basis of the information provided by them in their online applications. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates for written, skill test, or interview to a reasonable limit based on qualifications, level, and relevance of experience.

content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Important Instructions
content_sections.text: All positions are on a purely contract basis and completion of the contract period will not confer any right for regularisation or permanency. Applicants working in any project at IIT Madras must apply through proper channel or produce a No-Objection Certificate at the time of document verification, test, or interview. Applications cannot be edited or reverted once submitted. Candidates should not attempt to apply twice for the same post. The crucial date for determining eligibility criteria in every respect is the prescribed closing date for submission of online applications. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. For technical issues during application submission, contact via email at [email protected] / [email protected] or phone at 044-2257 9796 (Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM, except National Holidays).
